title: Self-Discovering Interpretable Diffusion Latent Directions for Responsible Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from profession-based text prompts (Winobias dataset), classifying the perceived gender of the output images using a CLIP classifier, and computing a deviation ratio metric to quantify representation imbalance across male and female attributes.

Generating images from profession-based text prompts, classifying the perceived race (black, white, Asian) of the output images using a CLIP classifier, and computing a deviation ratio metric to measure representational disparities across racial groups.
